attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Michigan state income tax calculation. Implements flat 4.25% tax rate with personal exemptions per MI tax code (2025).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Michigan Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_comment: Filing status is Married Filing Jointly
Filing status is Head of Household

action_details.action_postfix:
result.mi_exemption_single result.number_of_dependents result.mi_exemption_dependent mul add /result.mi_total_exemption xdef
"MI exemptions (Single): $" result.mi_total_exemption cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Married Filing Jointly: base exemption (2 x $5,800) + dependent exemptions
action_details.action_postfix:
result.mi_exemption_married result.number_of_dependents result.mi_exemption_dependent mul add /result.mi_total_exemption xdef
"MI exemptions (MFJ): $" result.mi_total_exemption cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Head of Household: base exemption + dependent exemptions
action_details.action_postfix:
result.mi_exemption_single result.number_of_dependents result.mi_exemption_dependent mul add /result.mi_total_exemption xdef
"MI exemptions (HOH): $" result.mi_total_exemption cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Other statuses: base exemption + dependent exemptions
action_details.action_postfix:
result.mi_exemption_single result.number_of_dependents result.mi_exemption_dependent mul add /result.mi_total_exemption xdef
"MI exemptions (Other): $" result.mi_total_exemption cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Calculate MI taxable income (AGI - exemptions, minimum 0)
action_details.action_postfix:
result.agi result.mi_total_exemption sub 0 max /result.mi_taxable_income xdef
"MI taxable income: $" result.mi_taxable_income cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

result.mi_taxable_income result.mi_tax_rate mul /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"Michigan tax calculated: $" result.state_tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Michigan military retirement income exclusion. Provides 100% exclusion for military retirement pay and SBP payments. Honors MSRRA (spouse income exempt if different domicile) and SCRA (active duty pay exempt if different state of residence). Per MCL § 206.30 (2025).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Michigan Military Retirement Exclusion Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0 /result.mi_military_retirement_exclusion xdef 0 /result.mi_sbp_exclusion xdef
initial_action.action_comment: Initialize Michigan military retirement exclusion calculation

action_details.action_comment: Apply full exclusion for military retirement pay and SBP payments
action_details.action_postfix:
taxpayer.military_retirement_pay /result.mi_military_retirement_exclusion xdef
taxpayer.sbp_payments 0 gt { taxpayer.sbp_payments /result.mi_sbp_exclusion xdef } if
result.mi_military_retirement_exclusion result.mi_sbp_exclusion add /result.mi_total_military_exclusion xdef
result.agi result.mi_total_military_exclusion sub 0 max /result.mi_adjusted_agi xdef
"Michigan military retirement exclusion: $" result.mi_military_retirement_exclusion cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.mi_sbp_exclusion 0 gt { "Michigan SBP exclusion: $" result.mi_sbp_exclusion cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto } if "Michigan total military exclusion: $" result.mi_total_military_exclusion cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
